extracted.name: Spicy microwave popcorn
extracted.description: Enjoy a snack that’s healthier than crisps. Sesame oil adds flavour and helps the spices stick to the popcorn, but you can use olive or rapeseed oil instead
instruction_lines: Tip the corn kernels into a large heatproof bowl, cover and microwave for 5-8 mins, or until the popping stops.
Stir in the oil and spices, and toss well to coat. Will keep in an airtight container for up to a week.
